source_contract.character_source: Every card depends on an independently registered RGBA character asset. A flat card PNG is never a character source.
source_contract.layer_files: background_base, faction_pattern, character and frame remain independently addressable authoring/runtime elements.
source_contract.frame_character_order: The base frame is rendered behind the character. Only dedicated foreground effects and UI plates may overlay the standee; five-star cards do not use break-frame motion.
source_contract.dynamic_identity: Name, position, rarity marks, faction label and any six-star flagship title are rendered by UI/vector layers.
source_contract.derived_preview: The source card PNG is a reproducible preview derived from the layer graph, not a new source of truth.

recipes.element_budget: One flat faction watermark; no particles, trails, signature or theme title.
One repeated geometric texture, one material-edition badge and at most one restrained linear-particle layer; no skill name or skill icon.
One rear action trail and one restrained foreground particle layer; no theme title, edition badge, skill information or signature.
Iridescent fragments, outline light and one break-frame motion layer are allowed; only this tier may use the fictional signature mark.
